summary: Frappe HR is a human resources management system covering thirteen distinct modules. It manages internal organizational data including staff records, onboarding processes, leave tracking, payroll computation, and tax calculations.
goodFor: Organisations looking for a comprehensive, self-hosted human resources suite that covers everything from initial staff onboarding to monthly payroll processing under a single application.
watchOut: Deploying and maintaining an extensive enterprise HRM platform built on the Frappe framework requires familiarity with its specific ecosystem, database management, and regular administrative overhead.
deployNotes: As a Python and Node.js application, deployment typically relies on Docker alongside a persistent relational database backend and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
